meta.read_rule: Use Qoovex-Brain as the canonical operational memory.

project.name: Qoovex
project.audience: small construction businesses, subcontractors, craftspeople and safety consultants
project.positioning: The simplest system for small businesses and subcontractors to keep documents, deadlines and construction-site evidence ready.

notes: This file is intentionally minimal to avoid duplicated operational memory in the repo.
Detailed rules, decisions, feature constraints and failure modes are canonical in Qoovex-Brain.

technical_state.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 is installed with CSS-first configuration in the Next.js apps.
technical_state.typography: Sirio, web and workspace load Geist and Geist Mono through next/font; @qoovex/brand-resources is asset-only.
technical_state.design_system: @qoovex/ui is the canonical shadcn base-nova foundation with Base UI, Tabler and the Vercel light/dark/system theme. Sirio, web and workspace consume explicit package subpaths.
technical_state.motion: The shared foundation implements circular theme reveal, floating navigation and Base UI state transitions with reduced-motion and unsupported-browser fallbacks.
technical_state.workspace_architecture: FSD aliases are configured. Flow-by-flow migration has not started.
